description: This Java class 'ExtensionData' represents a data model used for interoperation in the Finerae project. It contains fields for a key-value pair, validation logic, and utility methods for parsing JSON data with validation support.

classes.name: ExtensionData
classes.description: A data holder class for extension key-value pairs with validation and JSON parsing logic.

methods.name: validateAndParse
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON object into an ExtensionData instance, utilizing provided validator and JSON helper.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of this extension data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for the extension data.
